clips.label: מהחלקה לריצה קדימה

clips.label: מהחלקה לריצה לאחור
clips.notes: Slide while the travel direction swings from +X to -Z; the body keeps facing +Z and ends in a backpedal.

exit.note: backward run; no reference backpedal exists, bridge to defensive_stance or the game backward gait

clips.label: חיתוך 70 מעלות שמאלה
clips.notes: Run in, plant the outside foot wide, the body leads the turn, drive off the plant foot onto a new heading of 70 degrees; exit.bodyYawDegrees says how far the pelvis is yawed in the clip frame.

clips.label: עצירה ופיבוט שמאלה
clips.notes: Stride stop onto the left foot, the left sole stays planted while the pelvis turns 90 degrees around it and the right foot steps around; ends in the ready stance yawed 90 degrees (exit.bodyYawDegrees).

clips.label: יציאה מעמידה, שלושה צעדים
clips.notes: Drive lean, push from the left foot, three accelerating steps (right, left, right) into a run of about 4.3 m/s.
